meta.name: understand-diff
meta.description: Use when you need to analyze git diffs or pull requests to understand what changed, affected components, and risks

copy.tagline: 分析代码变更，理解影响与风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要审查代码变更或理解他人提交的影响
copy.tagline_en: Analyze code changes to understand impact and risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to review code changes or understand the impact of others' commits

howto.what: 它会对照项目知识图谱分析代码变更（git diff或PR），找出变更文件、受影响组件和架构层，评估风险，输出分析并写入diff-overlay.json供可视化。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析git diff或pull request，或需要理解代码变更、受影响组件与风险时触发。

say.text: 分析一下当前的代码改动有哪些风险？
say.note: 会对照知识图谱找出受影响组件。

say.text: 帮我看看这个PR的变更会影响哪些模块？
say.note: 会获取该PR的差异并给出结构化分析。

say.text: 这次改动的受影响组件和架构层是什么？
say.note: 输出变更、受影响组件与风险。

howto.what_en: Claude matches your git diff or pull request against the project knowledge graph, identifies changed files, affected components and layers, assesses risk, and returns a structured summary. It also writes diff-overlay.json for the dashboard.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to analyze a git diff or pull request, or wants to know what changed, affected components, and risks.

say_en.text: Analyze the risks in my current code changes.
say_en.note: Maps changes to the graph and lists affected parts.

say_en.text: What modules would this PR affect?
say_en.note: Fetches the PR diff and provides a structured analysis.

say_en.text: Which components and layers are impacted by this change?
say_en.note: Reports changed and affected components with risk.
